selected_evidence.summary: Both controllers are active; every naming context replicated successfully in both directions and both databases report zero errors.
Directory, DNS, Kerberos, and SMB routes/listeners use enp8s0 and 10.100.173.10-13; management-address identity listeners are absent.
engineering contains infrasetuser, and the identity plus member/client machine accounts are replicated to NODE2.
node3 serves the group-writable share with the required welcome.txt content; node4 is joined, has the root-owned mode-0600 environment file, and completed authenticated read/write access.

After a healthy baseline, NODE1 was stopped; NODE2 supplied DNS and a fresh Kerberos ticket while node3 failed over NETLOGON and node4 retained writable SMB access. NODE1 then recovered and resynchronized.
NODE1 supplied DNS and fresh authentication while NODE2 was stopped; Kerberos and password-based SMB access succeeded, then NODE2 recovered and resynchronized.
Healthy baseline and acknowledgement captured; boot ID changed from 872e… to a727…, followed by complete AD/DNS/data/replication recovery.
Healthy baseline and acknowledgement captured; boot ID changed from e5bd… to 06c4…, followed by complete controller recovery.
Boot ID changed from 8e0d… to fc2c…; domain trust, Winbind, SMB, permissions, data, and external read/write access recovered.
Boot ID changed from 6693… to 3cd1…; join state, Winbind, protected credentials, DNS, Kerberos, and writable SMB access recovered.
